_comment: Copy to metrics.config.json (gitignored) and fill in the real locationIds. Tokens come from env vars named by tokenEnv — never inline them here.
_tiles_help: Each business may set an optional 'tiles' array to override the default (Contacts / Open / Won / Lost). All tile types are read-only GET calls. Types: {label,type:'contacts'} = total contacts; {label,type:'opportunities',status:'open|won|lost'} = opportunities by status; {label,type:'stage',pipelineId,stageId} = opportunities in a pipeline stage (use for trials / active members / past-due when modeled as pipeline stages).
